summary.text: Susan Zhuang represents the 43rd District on the New York City Council, which includes parts of Sunset Park, Dyker Heights, Bensonhurst, Bath Beach and Borough Park in Brooklyn.
Her Council biography says she was elected in 2023, re-elected in 2025, and is the first Chinese-American Council Member elected to represent Brooklyn.

paragraphs.text: Zhuang was born in Baipu, China, and came to the United States in 2007 as an international student, according to her Council biography.
She earned a bachelor's degree in finance from SUNY Oswego and an MBA from the University of Southern Indiana.
She volunteered in the office of Assemblyman William Colton helping seniors and small businesses file tax returns, and became his Chief of Staff in 2014.

She chairs the Committee on Aging, and the biography lists her legislative work as including expanding Meals on Wheels services, establishing Chinese American Railroad Workers Memorial Day, and a mandate that the Department of Health inspect rat complaints.
She lives in Bensonhurst with her husband and two young daughters.
